question: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1'** i.e. **'Trunk'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Trnuk:** This is not a valid English word, so it is incorrectly spelled.
 
• The **correct spelling** is **"trunk".**
 
• **It refers** to the main woody stem of a tree, the main part of a person's body excluding the limbs and head, or a large box used for transporting or storing items."(तना/शरीर/पेटी) 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Trunk'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Blade: **This word is spelled correctly. A blade is the flat cutting edge of a knife, saw, or other tool or weapon.
 
• **Mentor: **This word is spelled correctly. A mentor is a person who gives a younger or less experienced person help and advice over a period of time, especially at work or school.(मार्गदर्शक)
 
• **Dinner: **This word is spelled correctly. Dinner typically refers to the most substantial meal of the day, which can be eaten at midday or in the evening. It can also refer to a formal evening meal.(रात का भोजन)
